sections.Profile:
"Contest," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1958, is a four-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. The playfield features two flippers, two pop bumpers, and a central roto-target, offering players engaging gameplay.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1958
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Pinball, Original Theme
